title: Task scale
statement: A deterministic Goldreich–Levin task consists of a deterministic Goldreich–Levin input together with a Boolean function on the sign cube of the input dimension. Define the task scale to be the runtime scale of its input.
caveat: The supplied material does not define runtime scale or the precise Boolean-function notation used here.
